title: The Subir Falls Circuit, Girmal to Dev Van

stops.note: The Gira hairpin from the deck, chai while the cloud decides
Gujarat's tallest, three kilometres on, the circuit's anchor
The quiet western fall nobody else detours for
Check in, river walk, forest night, the circuit's bed
Karanjwa. The falls the campsite calls its own
Finish at the falls the reels call Wonder

day_notes.note: Ahwa to Subir to the Nishana check-post country: viewpoint, the big falls, the quiet one, then Mahal's bamboo forest for the night. Book the campsite ahead on the forest portal; fuel up in Ahwa: there are no pumps on the interior stretch.

The four-falls morning: Karanjwa, Milan, Bhalkhet and Dev Van sit within a dozen kilometres of village roads. None has facilities; carry the day's food and water from the campsite and ask each village for the path, local directions beat every map here.

notes: The densest waterfall cluster in the district, almost all of it documented nowhere else. Strictly a monsoon circuit, July to early October, and strictly a daylight one; grip footwear throughout.
